tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “¿Qué dice el cartel en la puerta?”

B hears the question and builds the answer without saying who does it: se + the blue verb, singular or plural like the thing (se alquila habitación, se venden sellos). The word se is not on a tile, you add it. Two answers use ser + participle instead (fue construida): the tile fue is given, you change the verb into the participle.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.
